subject: Unable to install on OS X 10.7.5

messages.author: a9fc767a51d12e9a
messages.subject: Unable to install on OS X 10.7.5
parts:
Hi,

I am having my own peculiar problems trying to install methylKit, on OS X 10.7.5.  When I open R and follow the install instruction from GitHub, this is what I get:

> library(devtools)
Warning message:
package ‘devtools’ was built under R version 3.2.5
> install_github("al2na/methylKit", build_vignettes=FALSE,
+   repos=BiocInstaller::biocinstallRepos(),
+   dependencies=TRUE)
Downloading GitHub repo al2na/methylKit@master
from URL https://api.github.com/repos/al2na/methylKit/zipball/master
Installing methylKit
trying URL 'http://probability.ca/cran/bin/macosx/contrib/3.2/emdbook_1.3.9'
Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  cannot open URL 'http://probability.ca/cran/bin/macosx/contrib/3.2/emdbook_1.3.9'
In addition: Warning message:
In download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  cannot open: HTTP status was '404 Not Found'
Warning in download.packages(x$name, destdir = dest_dir, repos = x$repos,  :
  download of package ‘emdbook’ failed
Error in download.packages(x$name, destdir = dest_dir, repos = x$repos,  :
  subscript out of bounds

I get the same message when adding type="source".

If I try the above with dependencies=F, I get:

> install_github("al2na/methylKit", build_vignettes=FALSE,
+   repos=BiocInstaller::biocinstallRepos(),
+   dependencies=F)
Downloading GitHub repo al2na/methylKit@master
from URL https://api.github.com/repos/al2na/methylKit/zipball/master
Installing methylKit
'/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' --no-site-file --no-environ --no-save --no-restore --quiet CMD INSTALL  \
  '/private/var/folders/pd/3vkzqgqs6qn4405507d5ryjc0000gn/T/Rtmpy7jj9M/devtoolsb26276eab50a/al2na-methylKit-a9f1f93' --library='/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library' --install-tests

ERROR: this R is version 3.2.1, package 'methylKit' requires R >= 3.3.0
Error: Command failed (1)

Since I have OS X 10.7.5, I am not able to install R version 3.3.1 which is only for >= OS X 10.9 ; instead, I have to install R 3.2.1 as shown on https://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/

Lastly, when I try to execute R CMD INSTALL methylKit_0.9.2.tar.gz from the terminal I get the following:

* installing to library ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library’
* installing *source* package ‘methylKit’ ...
** R
** data
** exec
** inst
** preparing package for lazy loading
Error : objects ‘DataFrame’, ‘Rle’, ‘elementMetadata’, ‘elementMetadata<-’ are not exported by 'namespace:IRanges'
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘methylKit’
* removing ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/methylKit’

I get exactly the same message even when trying R CMD INSTALL methylKit_0.5.7.tar.gz

The BioConductor version I'm using is 3.2 but it seems that 3.3 will only work with version >= 3.3.0.

I would greatly appreciate any help for this issue.  Please let me know if you need more info.

Thank you,
Rajat

Using Bioconductor 3.2 (BiocInstaller 1.20.3), R 3.2.1 (2015-06-18).

Any idea what may be amiss here?  Should I try upgrading my OS X?

Thanks again for your time,
Rajat
